headline: LMW announces changes to its board of directors
hook: Boardroom shuffle at machinery maker LMW
summary: LMW Limited has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding a change in its board of directors. The announcement details routine corporate governance updates typical of listed manufacturing entities. No financial impact or operational changes were disclosed in the brief filing. Retail investors in industrial machinery stocks should note that board changes at this stage are procedural.
why_it_matters: Routine board filing with no immediate stock impact
